insurer: Aditya Birla Health Insurance Co. Limited
sumInsured: Not specified (as per Policy Schedule / Product Benefit Table)

great.name: No Claim Bonus
great.quote: The accumulated No Claim Bonus shall not exceed 50% of the Sum Insured on the Renewed Policy. In the event of a claim impacting the eligibility of a No Claim Bonus, the accumulated No Claim Bonus shall be reduced by 10% of the Sum Insured at the commencement of subsequent Policy Year.
great.explanation: No Claim Bonus can build up to 50% of Sum Insured, and after a claim it reduces by only 10% (instead of resetting to zero). This helps you retain most of your accumulated bonus even if you make a claim.

good.name: Restore Benefit
good.quote: Once in the Policy Year, We shall provide for a reload of the Sum Insured... Reload of Sum Insured shall be available only once during a Policy Year... (iii) The reload of Sum Insured shall be available only for subsequent claims and not in relation to any Illness/ Injury (including its complications) for which a claim has been admitted for the Insured Person during that Policy Year.
good.reference: Section C.I.(h) Reload of Sum Insured
good.explanation: Sum Insured reload is available once in a policy year, only for subsequent claims and not for the same illness/injury (or its complications) already claimed that year. This gives an extra buffer for a different medical event in the same year, but won’t help if the same condition needs more treatment.

good.name: Initial Waiting Period
good.quote: 30-day waiting period (Code- Excl03) i. Expenses related to the treatment of any illness within 30 days from the ﬁrst policy commencement date shall be excluded except claims arising due to an accident
good.explanation: Illness-related treatment is not covered for the first 30 days from the first policy start date, except for accidents. This is a standard waiting period and means non-accident claims in the first month will be rejected.

good.name: Specific Illness Waiting Period
good.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of the listed Conditions, surgeries/treatments shall be excluded until the expiry of 24 months of continuous coverage after the date of inception of the ﬁrst policy with Us.
good.explanation: Listed diseases/procedures are not covered until you complete 24 months of continuous coverage from the first policy inception. This delays coverage for those specific conditions for the first 2 years.

good.name: Domiciliary Hospitalization
good.quote: We shall cover the Medical Expenses incurred for the Insured Person’s Domiciliary Hospitalization, up to the limits as speciﬁed in the Policy Schedule / Product Beneﬁt Table of this Policy
good.explanation: Home treatment (domiciliary hospitalization) is covered up to the limits shown in the Policy Schedule/Product Benefit Table. This can help when treatment is needed at home instead of being admitted to a hospital.

good.name: Pre-hospitalization Cover
good.quote: We shall cover on a reimbursement basis, up to the Sum Insured for the number of days in accordance with the limit as speciﬁed in the Policy Schedule / Product Beneﬁt Table of this Policy, the Insured Person’s Pre-hospitalization Medical Expenses
good.explanation: Pre-hospitalization medical expenses are reimbursed for the number of days shown in the Policy Schedule/Product Benefit Table. This helps pay for consultations/tests before admission, but the day-limit depends on your plan.

good.name: Post-hospitalization Cover
good.quote: We shall cover on a reimbursement basis, up to the Sum Insured for the number of days speciﬁed in the Policy Schedule / Product Beneﬁt Table of this Policy, the Insured Person’s Post-hospitalization Medical Expenses
good.explanation: Post-hospitalization medical expenses are reimbursed for the number of days shown in the Policy Schedule/Product Benefit Table. This helps cover follow-up medicines/tests after discharge, but the day-limit depends on your plan.

bad.name: Room Rent
bad.quote: Reasonable and Customary Charges for Room Rent... up to the limits as speciﬁed in the Policy Schedule / Product Beneﬁt Table of this Policy; ... If the Insured Person is admitted in a room category/limit that is higher than the one that is speciﬁed... then the Insured Person shall bear a rateable proportion of the total Associated Medical Expenses
bad.reference: Section C.I.(a) In-patient Hospitalization (Room rent) + Conditions (2)
bad.explanation: Room rent is limited as per the Policy Schedule/Product Benefit Table, and choosing a higher room category triggers a proportionate (rateable) share of associated medical expenses. This can significantly increase out-of-pocket costs if you take a room above your eligibility.

bad.name: Consumables
bad.quote: Non-Medical Expenses... as speciﬁed in the Annexure I - Non- Medical Expenses... List I - Items for which coverage is not available in the policy... 56 GLOVES ... 60 MASK ... 58 ANY KIT WITH NO DETAILS MENTIONED [DELIVERY KIT, ORTHOKIT, RECOVERY KIT, ETC]
bad.reference: Section D.II.(50) + Annexure I (Non-medical expenses list)
bad.explanation: Non-medical/consumable items listed in Annexure I (e.g., gloves, masks, and various kits) are not covered. This means you will pay these common hospital charges from your own pocket during hospitalization.

bad.name: Co-pay
bad.quote: At the time of inception... if the Age... is 61 years or above... shall bear a Co-payment per claim... as speciﬁed in Product Beneﬁt Table/Policy Schedule.
bad.explanation: If age at inception is 61 years or above, a co-payment per claim applies as per the Product Benefit Table/Policy Schedule. This means you must pay a fixed percentage/amount of every claim yourself, increasing your out-of-pocket costs.

unclear.name: PED Waiting Period
unclear.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of a pre-existing Disease (PED)... shall be excluded until the expiry of years / months as speciﬁed in the Policy Schedule / Product Beneﬁt Table of this Policy
unclear.explanation: Pre-existing diseases are not covered until you complete the waiting period mentioned in the Policy Schedule/Product Benefit Table. The exact duration is not stated here, so you must verify the number of months/years in your schedule before buying.

disclaimer: Standard IRDAI exclusions apply. Please verify all details with your insurer or policy document.
